title: 第10章 我叫陆阳，是个读书人
novel_title: 都重生了谁还复读？去当兵吧(酸辣榔头)
content_zh: “各班，留一个收拾碗筷！”吃完饭，新兵们由各班班长带回。桌上剩下的碗筷，得留下一个新兵来收拾，也就是所谓的小值日。三班被留下的，自然是丁腾飞这个倒霉蛋。吃，没他的份，却得被留下收拾打扫残局，简直杀人诛心。【检测到新知识点：不打勤的，不打懒的，专打不长眼！】【知识点分析：在部队里，当什么都别当刺头，因为老兵最喜欢做的就是拔刺！】陆阳一愣，没想到这系统还像个百科全书似的，竟然还会对先前发生的一幕进行总结？这是生怕他会在部队里踩雷，犯同样的错误啊？……离开食堂后，众人并未返回宿舍，而是跟着周凯东去领取生活用品。部队里，毛巾，牙刷，牙膏，脸盆一类的生活用品都是统一发放。回头各自用黑笔写上名字，用以区分，也不用担心会拿错。“班长，这不对啊，咋就这一个盆？”刚领完东西出来，孔垄就察觉到不对劲。其他人也后知后觉的反应过来，感觉到好像少了点什么。是啊，怎么才发了一个盆？回头洗脚，洗屁股，洗衣服怎么办？周凯东的回答是，凉拌。但陆阳知道，这东西的作用，可不止洗脸洗脚洗衣服，还有各种你们想都不敢想的用途。但他不想说，毕竟大家刚吃饱饭，说出来实在倒胃口。但周凯东可不像陆阳这么有底线，直接就把万能的小黄盆终极使用方法，尽可能详细的描述出来。给这帮新兵整得脸色要多难看有多难看，差点没当场对着花坛来一波人工施肥。恶作剧成功的周凯东笑哈哈的，扭头看见陆阳竟然没反应，立马就有些不乐意了。“怎么，你见识过我先前说的粪海狂蛆的画面？”“来之前，我在贴吧里看过用小黄盆掏粪的照片，后劲儿很大......两天没能吃下饭。”陆阳说的是实话，当初那些退伍老兵告诫他，千万不要去搜。但人类的好奇心，还是让他抑制不住的去搜索了那张图片，差点没被恶心吐了。……众人领完东西刚返回宿舍，外面哨声便再次响起。值班员在楼下喊话：“各班拿着行李，走廊整队集合，下楼点验！”“点验？”新兵们一脸懵，显然不明白这是什么意思。但陆阳有系统做科普，立马就能得到详细信息。所谓点验，就是清点新兵行李里的私人物品，登记后统一存放。而点验，也被称之为部队里的大型社死环节。因为在接受点验时，你将没有任何秘密可言。很快，新兵们就提着行囊来到楼下准备接受点验。地上铺着一张张凉席，班排长们就站在边上，手里拿着登记表，准备详细清点记录新兵们的私人物品。这时，陆阳注意到连长身旁，多了个戴眼镜的上尉。看着斯斯文文，慈眉善目的，应该就是新兵连的指导员了。指导员何镇涛提醒道：“大家在点验物品时，一定要注意轻拿轻放，一定一定不要损坏新兵的私人物品。”就这么一句话，就让新兵们对于这个和和气气的指导员好感倍增。至少他看起来没连长那么凶，瞧着就比较好说话的样子。但陆阳知道这些都是假象，部队里通常一个唱红脸一个唱白脸，都是工作需要。如果真有人蠢到把指导员当成自已人，跑去告状说坏话，那绝对够你喝一壶的。随着点验开始，各班新兵的私人物品被一件件的翻出来，摆放在凉席上。大家带的东西也都是千奇百怪，少部分甚至可以用匪夷所思来形容。“你带这么多内裤做什么？”“怕不够穿。”“你长几个屁股，带特么五十条裤衩子？还都是花裤衩！”……“这破毛毯是什么玩意儿，怎么还把家里抹布带来了？”“这不是破抹布，这是阿贝贝。”“啊，啊什么？”“我从小到大都得攥着它睡觉，不然会睡不着，班长能给我留下吗？”“他特么怎么不把奶瓶一块带来？”……三班这边，周凯东刚刚点验完孔垄的私人物品，除了一些贴身衣物，几乎都是各种补剂。什么维生素C，鱼肝油，肌酸，氮泵，各种口味的小包装蛋白粉。“你拿部队当免费健身房，办年卡来了？”“在单子上签字，按个手印。”孔垄老老实实的在单子上签字画押，东西全部被统一收纳。因为涉及到电子产品，现金，银行卡一类的贵重物品，所以细节上必须得足够严谨。下一个是丁腾飞，周凯东知道这小子不安分，却没想到刚开始点验，就出现了严重违禁物品。这是一根三十公分长的金属棍子，轻轻一甩，能延长到六七十公分。“当兵，你带甩棍来，是什么意思？”“防身的。”“防谁，防你战友，还是防班长？”见三班这边有状况，指导员何镇涛走了上来。“怎么回事？”“点出个违禁品。”“多大点事，登记上就是了，年轻人出门在外缺少安全感，带个东西防身能理解。”何镇涛的打圆场，让丁腾飞嬉皮笑脸，似是得到了理解，立马就把指导员当成了自已人。紧跟着，周凯东又从包里取出一枚指虎，再然后是一把蝴蝶刀。这下子，指导员的脸上都有些挂不住，询问他带这些东西来部队做什么？丁腾飞不以为意：“这些都是我朋友送的，当时还有人送了我一把黄河手枪。我寻思，部队里应该发枪，就没带来？”丁腾飞自以为幽默的发言，让班长周凯东脸色很是难看。还特么想自已带枪来部队，你特么怎么不去死？但凡是在宿舍里，但凡没外人在，他已经一个飞踢，外加大嘴巴抽上去了。别说是在部队里，即便是在社会上，这些东西都属于严重违禁品。“黄河手枪，呵呵......”指导员皮笑肉不笑，说了句小伙子还挺幽默的，但心里已经把丁腾飞添加上重点关注的黑名单了。他扭过头，和连长对了个眼神，二人什么都没说，但却在这件事上达成默契。接下来，即便周凯东在带兵工作中出现些许过激行为，他们也会睁一只眼闭一只眼，表示理解。对于某些长期缺乏管教，在外头打架斗殴惹事生非，并拥有一定暴力倾向的年轻人。讲道理是不听的，感化也是没用的，只能是“以刚克刚”“以武止戈”。但丁腾飞的离谱，还不仅于此，周凯东在翻开他的钱包，清点银行卡和现金数量时候，竟从夹层里翻出两个小雨伞。周凯东拳头捏的咯咯响，脖子上青筋一跳一跳的，显然是被这王八犊子给气炸了。“来，告诉班长，你带这玩意儿到部队里，是什么意思？”“你这是有什么特殊爱好，还是想在背后，对你的战友捅刺刀？”听到这话，包括陆阳在内的三班全体新兵，全都虎躯一震。看向丁腾飞的目光带着浓浓的警惕，像是人群中出了个叛徒。丁腾飞依旧是一脸嬉笑的无所谓态度：“之前用剩下的，忘在钱包里了。”“你有对象？”“没有啊？”“那你说的用剩下，是什么意思？”“我靠！班长你这么传统的嘛？都什么年代了，就非得处对象嘛，就不能是认得干妹妹什么的？”这一刻，几乎所有人对于这个言语轻佻，道德感极低家伙的感观印象都差到极点。陆阳也觉得，这家伙说话做事完全不经过脑子，简直就是口无遮拦。这种违背公序良俗的话当众张口就来，表情还透着一股自豪，好像很了不起似的。看到班长周凯东额头一跳一跳的青筋，似是在强压内心怒火，孔垄心里已经开始呐喊。“打他呀，打他妈的！”但终究，三期老兵士官的素养，还是让周凯东克制住。并全程压着火气，完成了对于丁腾飞的点验。接下来几个新兵，都很正常，带的东西也多是洗护用品一类，没有什么特别之处，这也让周凯东的怒气减弱几分。终于轮到陆阳了，他主动配合着打开背包，里头塞得满满当当全是书！尤其是瞧见，还有两本中英文字典时候，周凯东眼角狂跳！你管这玩意儿叫家乡特产？妈的，难怪之前放行李时，差点闪了腰！谁家来当兵，带这么多书过来，你看得完吗？“你带这么多书来部队做什么？”问出这话的不是周凯东，而是忽然出现在面前的指导员。陆阳老实回答：“报告指导员，以前我没好好念书，看着其他人都考上大学才知道后悔，才知道读书学习的重要性！”“我想在部队里，利用课余时间好好复习，争取能够考学上军校！”何镇涛眼前一亮，还挺有志气：“你叫什么名字？”“报告，我叫陆阳。”“亡羊补牢，为时不晚，现在知道用功也不算晚，好好加油！”“不过，新兵连可没时间给你看书，这些得等下连以后，才能回还给你。”“是！”什么叫鲜明对比！什么叫前后差异！从不学无术，烂泥扶不上墙的丁鹏飞；到清晰认识到学习重要性，决心在部队里好好干，争取考学上军校的陆阳！何镇涛就像是在一坨臭狗屎旁边发现一块璞玉，实在让他有种意外之喜，也让他对于陆阳的第一印象十分不错。周凯东甚至主动汇报：“指导员，我可以作证，他坐火车来的这一路，基本都在认真看书。”何镇涛本就是个文化人，听到这话更是欣慰的很，越看陆阳越觉得格外顺眼。就在他准备号召大家向陆阳同志学习，不要因为一时失利而挫败，要始终保持一颗积极向上的心时，九班那边突然传来什么动静。不少新兵都在使劲憋着笑，而连长高峰则蹲在地上，似乎还被蒙在鼓里？他把玩着一个造型奇特，上头印着蒂法形象的塑料保温杯：“这个兵有点儿意思啊，大老远的还带个杯子过来，这玩意儿前后都通着，装水不会漏嘛？”那个新兵涨红了脸，支支吾吾的不敢言语。指导员走上去，仅瞧了一眼就哭笑不得。他俯下身子，靠在连长耳边说了些什么。反应过来的高峰眼睛瞪得像铜铃，气的怒骂：“他奶奶的，这玩意儿居然都敢带到部队里来了，你是想起飞啊？”
content_en: "Each class, leave one person to clean up the dishes!" After the meal, the recruits were brought back by the monitors of each class.A recruit must be left to clean up the remaining dishes and chopsticks on the table, which is the so-called small duty day.The one left behind in Class 3 was naturally the unlucky guy Ding Tengfei.He had no share of the food, but he had to be left to clean up the mess. It was heartbreaking.[New knowledge points detected: If you don’t fight hard, you won’t fight lazy, and if you only fight hard, you won’t have a good eye!】【Knowledge point analysis: In the army, don’t treat yourself as a thorn in anything, because what veterans like to do most is to pull out thorns!] Lu Yang was stunned. He didn't expect that this system was like an encyclopedia, and it would even summarize the previous scene?Is this because you are afraid that he will step on a trap in the army and make the same mistake?...After leaving the cafeteria, everyone did not return to the dormitory, but followed Zhou Kaidong to collect daily necessities.In the army, daily necessities such as towels, toothbrushes, toothpaste, and wash basins are distributed uniformly.When you turn around, write each person's name with a black pen to distinguish them, so you don't have to worry about picking up the wrong one."Squad leader, this isn't right. Why just this basin?" As soon as he came out after receiving the things, Kong Rong noticed something was wrong.Others also reacted belatedly, feeling that something was missing.Yes, why did you get a basin?What should I do if I go back to washing my feet, washing my butt, and washing my clothes?Zhou Kaidong’s answer is, cold salad.But Lu Yang knows that this thing can be used not only for washing your face, feet, and clothes, but also for various uses that you can't even imagine.But he didn't want to say it. After all, everyone had just eaten, and it was really off-putting to say it.But Zhou Kaidong was not as bottom-lined as Lu Yang, so he directly described the ultimate use method of the all-purpose little yellow basin in as much detail as possible.The faces of these new recruits were so ugly that they almost did not artificially fertilize the flower beds on the spot.Zhou Kaidong laughed loudly after the prank was successful. He turned around and saw that Lu Yang didn't respond, and he immediately became unhappy."Why, have you seen the scene of the crazy maggots in the dung sea that I mentioned earlier?" "Before I came here, I saw photos of people using small yellow basins to scoop out excrement in the forum. It was very powerful...I couldn't eat for two days." Lu Yang was telling the truth. The veterans warned him not to search.But human curiosity still made him unable to restrain himself and searched for the picture, almost making him sick.... As soon as everyone returned to the dormitory after collecting their things, the whistle sounded again outside.The duty officer shouted downstairs: "Each class will take their luggage, gather in the corridor, and go downstairs for inspection!" "Examination?" The recruits looked confused, obviously not understanding what this meant.But Lu Yang has a system for popular science and can get detailed information immediately.The so-called inspection is to count the personal belongings in the recruits' luggage and store them together after registration.The inspection is also called a large-scale social link in the army.Because when you're being tested, you won't have any secrets to keep.Soon, the recruits came downstairs with their bags to prepare for the test.There were mats spread out on the ground, and the squad and platoon leaders were standing nearby, holding registration forms in their hands, preparing to record in detail the recruits' personal belongings.At this time, Lu Yang noticed that there was a captain wearing glasses next to the company commander.Seemingly polite and kind, he must be the instructor of the recruit company.Instructor He Zhentao reminded: "When checking items, everyone must handle them with care and be sure not to damage the recruits' personal belongings." Just such a sentence made the recruits have a good impression of this kind and kind instructor.At least he doesn't look as fierce as the company commander, and he seems to be easier to talk to.But Lu Yang knows that these are all illusions. In the army, one is usually a good person and the other is a bad person. This is all due to work needs.If someone is really stupid enough to treat the instructor as one of their own, complain and say bad things, that will definitely be enough to make you drink.As the inspection began, the personal belongings of each class of recruits were dug out one by one and placed on the mats.The things everyone brought were also all kinds of strange, and a few of them could even be described as bizarre."Why do you bring so many underwear?" "Afraid you don't have enough to wear." "How many butts do you have to wear fifty pairs of underwear? They are all flowery underwear!"... "What is this tattered blanket? Why did you bring the rag from home?" "This is not a rag, this is Abeibei." "Ah, ah"What?""I've had to hold it to sleep since I was a child, otherwise I wouldn't be able to sleep. Can the squad leader keep it for me?""Why the hell didn't he bring the bottle with him?"... In class three, Zhou Kaidong had just checked Kong Long's personal belongings, which were mostly all kinds of supplements except for some personal clothes.What about vitamin C, cod liver oil, creatine, nitrogen pump, small packaged protein powder in various flavors."You use the army as a free gym and are you here to apply for an annual pass?" "Sign on the list and put your thumbprint." Kong Long conscientiously signed and stamped on the list, and everything was stored together.Because it involves valuable items such as electronic products, cash, and bank cards, the details must be rigorous enough.The next one was Ding Tengfei. Zhou Kaidong knew that this boy was restless, but he didn't expect that as soon as he started checking, serious prohibited items appeared.This is a thirty centimeter long metal stick that can be extended to sixty or seventy centimeters with a flick."Soldier, what do you mean by bringing a swinging stick?" "For self-defense." "Who to guard against, your comrades, or the squad leader?" Seeing that there was a situation in the third class, the instructor He Zhentao came up."What's going on?" "Call out a contraband." "No big deal, just register it. Young people lack a sense of security when going out, so it's understandable to bring something for self-defense." He Zhentao smoothed things over, which made Ding Tengfei smile playfully. He seemed to understand, and he immediately regarded the instructor as one of his own.Immediately afterwards, Zhou Kaidong took out another finger tiger from the bag, and then a butterfly knife.At this time, the instructor looked a little confused and asked him why he brought these things to the army.Ding Tengfei didn't take it seriously: "These were gifts from my friends. Someone also gave me a Yellow River pistol at that time. I thought, the army should issue guns, why didn't they bring them?" Ding Tengfei's self-proclaimed humorous speech made squad leader Zhou Kaidong look very ugly.You really want to bring your own gun to the army, why the hell don’t you die?Whenever he was in the dormitory, whenever no one was around, he would already kick him and hit him with a big mouth.Not to mention in the army, even in society, these things are serious contraband."Yellow River Pistol, haha..." The instructor said with a smile, the young man was quite humorous, but in his heart, he had already added Ding Tengfei to the blacklist to focus on.He turned his head and looked at the company commander. The two said nothing, but they reached a tacit understanding on this matter.Next, even if Zhou Kaidong behaves a little excessively while leading troops, they will turn a blind eye and express their understanding.For some young people who lack discipline for a long time, fight and cause trouble outside, and have certain violent tendencies.Reasoning is not listened to, and influence is useless. It can only be "conquering strength with strength" and "stopping war with force."Dante's outrageous behavior didn't stop there. When Zhou Kaidong opened his wallet and counted the bank cards and cash, he actually pulled out two small umbrellas from the mezzanine.Zhou Kaidong's fists clenched loudly and the veins on his neck jumped. He was obviously furious with this bastard."Come, tell the squad leader, what do you mean by bringing this thing into the army?" "Do you have any special hobbies, or do you want to stab your comrades in the back?" Upon hearing this, all the recruits in the third squad, including Lu Yang, were shocked.He looked at Ding Tengfei with deep vigilance, as if there was a traitor among the crowd.Ding Tengfei still had a playful and indifferent attitude: "I used the leftovers before and forgot them in my wallet." "Do you have a partner?" "No?" "Then what do you mean by using the leftovers?" "Damn it! Monitor, are you so traditional? What age are you, you have to find a partner, can't you recognize your sister or something?" At this moment, almost everyone had an extremely bad impression of this guy with frivolous words and extremely low moral sense.Lu Yang also felt that this guy spoke and did things without thinking at all, and he simply spoke without restraint.He spoke such words that violated public order and good customs in public, and his expression showed a sense of pride, as if he was something extraordinary.Seeing the veins on squad leader Zhou Kaidong's forehead jumping up and down, as if he was suppressing the anger in his heart, Kong Long began to scream in his heart."Hit him, beat him!" But in the end, the quality of the third-term veteran sergeant still made Zhou Kaidong restrain himself.And he suppressed his anger throughout the whole process and completed the test of Ding Tengfei.The next few recruits were all normal, and most of the things they brought were toiletries and toiletries. There was nothing special about them. This also made Zhou Kaidong's anger lessened a bit.Finally it was Lu Yang's turn. He took the initiative to open his backpack, which was stuffed full of books!Especially when he saw that there were two Chinese and English dictionaries, the corners of Zhou Kaidong's eyes jumped wildly!You call this a hometown specialty?Damn it, no wonder I almost lost my back when putting my luggage before!Who comes to serve as a soldier and brings so many books? Can you read them all?"Why did you bring so many books to the army?" It was not Zhou Kaidong who asked this question, but the instructor who suddenly appeared in front of him.Lu Yang answered honestly: "Reporting to the instructor, I didn't study hard before. I regretted it when I saw other people admitted to college, and then I realized the importance of studying and studying!" "I want to be in the army, use my spare time to review hard, and strive to be admitted to the military academy!" He Zhentao's eyes lit up, he was quite ambitious.Qi: "What's your name?" "Report, my name is Lu Yang." "It's not too late to make up for it. Now you know it's not too late to work hard, so work hard!" "However, the recruit company doesn't have time to read to you. These will have to wait until the next company to return them to you." "Yes!" What is a sharp contrast!What is the difference between before and after!From Ding Pengfei, who has no knowledge and skills, and can't support the wall with mud; to Lu Yang, who clearly understands the importance of learning, is determined to work hard in the army, and strives to be admitted to the military academy!He Zhentao felt like he found a piece of rough jade next to a pile of smelly dog ​​shit. It really gave him an unexpected joy and made his first impression of Lu Yang very good.Zhou Kaidong even took the initiative to report: "Instructor, I can testify that he was basically reading seriously during the train ride." He Zhentao was a cultural person, and he was even more pleased to hear this. The more he looked at Lu Yang, the more he felt particularly pleasing to the eye.Just when he was about to call on everyone to learn from Comrade Lu Yang, not to be frustrated by a temporary failure, but to always maintain a positive heart, something suddenly happened from Class 9.Many recruits were trying their best to hold back their laughter, while the company commander Gao Feng was squatting on the ground, seemingly still in the dark?He played with a plastic thermos cup with a strange shape and Tifa's image printed on it: "This soldier is a bit interesting. He brought a cup all the way here. This thing is connected from the front and back, so the water won't leak?" The recruit blushed and hesitated to speak.The instructor walked up and couldn't laugh or cry after just one glance.He leaned down and said something in the company commander's ear.After reacting, Gao Feng's eyes were as wide as copper bells, and he cursed angrily: "Grandma, you dare to bring this thing to the army. Do you want to take off?"
